name: Firecrawl
summary: 抓取网页、爬取整站并提取结构化数据，把网页变成 Agent 可用的 Markdown 或 JSON。
description: Firecrawl 官方 MCP 服务：单页抓取、站内爬取与映射、联网搜索、结构化提取和定时监控。授权时在浏览器登录 Firecrawl 并选择团队，令牌只保存在本机。
examples: 把这个产品页抓成 Markdown，保留标题和价格表
爬取 docs.example.com 的前 20 个页面，整理成一份知识摘要
搜索【固态电池量产进展】，把前 5 个结果的正文抓下来对比
按这个 JSON Schema 从招聘页面提取岗位、地点和薪资

help.label: 查看 Firecrawl MCP 说明
help.hint: 授权时在浏览器登录 Firecrawl 并选择团队；额度按账号套餐计，令牌只保存在本机。

en.summary: Scrape pages, crawl sites, and extract structured data for agents.
en.description: Official Firecrawl MCP service: page scraping, site crawling and mapping, web search, structured extraction, and scheduled monitoring. Sign in to Firecrawl in the browser and choose a team; the token stays on this machine.
examples: Scrape this product page to Markdown, keeping the title and price table
Crawl the first 20 pages of docs.example.com and produce a knowledge summary
Search for solid-state battery production progress and compare the top 5 results
Extract title, location, and salary from job pages using this JSON schema
